issues.issue: Whether the new evidence (repayment letter, newspaper screenshot, wife's decision notice) is admissible under s. 110(4)
issues.applicant_position: The new evidence should be admitted; it was needed to explain the contribution and the RPD's date error.
issues.result_quote: For these reasons, I find that the new evidence is not admissible.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred by not applying the Chairperson's SOGIE Guideline
issues.applicant_position: RPD failed to consider the Chairperson's SOGIE Guideline and did not explain why.
issues.result_quote: I agree with the Appellant that the RPD erred when it did not reference the Chairperson's SOGIE Guideline.

issues.issue: Whether the failure to claim asylum in the United States shows a lack of subjective fear
issues.applicant_position: RPD ignored his explanations: he lost hope after the US President's remarks, and he borrowed to fund his family's travel.
issues.result_quote: I agree with the RPD that the Appellant's failure to claim asylum in the United States of America is behaviour incompatible with someone who fears persecution or harm

issues.issue: Whether the RPD's error about the date of his wife's decision matters
issues.applicant_position: RPD misstated the date of his wife's decision.
issues.result_quote: I find that this error of fact is not relevant to the RPD's subjective fear finding.

issues.issue: Whether the tenancy and eviction documents were fabricated
issues.applicant_position: The receipts and eviction notice are material: he paid rent on time and was evicted for being bisexual.
issues.result_quote: Since the tenancy and eviction are allegations which are central to the Appellant's claim, I find that his presentation of fraudulent documents is a determinative factor

issues.issue: Whether the absence of evidence of harm to his children (barbaric practices, FGM) undermines credibility
issues.applicant_position: Makes no submissions on this finding.
issues.result_quote: While I agree with the RPD, I note that it is an issue peripheral to the Appellant's bisexuality claim and, therefore, not determinative

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred on why he left Nigeria and when his bisexuality became known
issues.applicant_position: RPD misapprehended the evidence on why he left and when his bisexuality became known.
issues.result_quote: I agree with the RPD that the Appellant provided inconsistent and contradictory evidence about his decision to leave Nigeria and when his bisexuality became known

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in giving no probative weight to the newspaper article
issues.applicant_position: RPD misapprehended the newspaper article and gave no reasons for not giving it weight.
issues.result_quote: The newspaper article has no probative value to corroborate the allegations of the Appellant and contributes to the negative credibility finding.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD correctly found no internal flight alternative in Port Harcourt
issues.applicant_position: RPD incorrectly assessed the first prong of the IFA test.
issues.result_quote: As credibility is the determinative issue, I did not consider the issue of an IFA in Port Harcourt.
